name: Original three-unit selection: unit-selection-lifecycle
description: Fresh Gaians/Citizen/standard original process on synthetic 40x80 flat arid land; declared UNIT1 and UNIT0 bonuses leave exactly one Scout, Former and Colony Pod after actual first-base construction. Pause-at-end enabled, tutorials disabled. Stacked starts MY2101 on the base, Scout selected, all ready. Spread uses real southeast/southwest moves, Skip and a turn, then starts MY2102 with Scout selected on the base, Former at (+1,+1) and Pod at (-1,+1), all ready. Positions are original coordinate units relative to the base, horizontal differences normalized for the round map. Native active-unit mode/identity, orders, movement spent in thirds and relative positions are observed. No combat, enemies, other orders, arbitrary topology, mouse selection or activation-picker claim.
